def build_client_session(api_key: Optional[str]=None, proxies: Optional[
    Dict[str, str]]=None, headers: Optional[Dict[str, str]]=None) ->Tuple[
    SafetyAuthSession, Dict[str, Any]]:
    from safety.auth.constants import OPENID_CONFIG_URL, CLIENT_ID
    
    client_session = SafetyAuthSession(
        client_id=CLIENT_ID,
        api_key=api_key
    )
    
    if proxies:
        client_session.proxies.update(proxies)
    
    if headers:
        client_session.headers.update(headers)
    
    openid_config = {}
    
    try:
        response = client_session.get(OPENID_CONFIG_URL, timeout=REQUEST_TIMEOUT)
        if response.status_code == 200:
            openid_config = response.json()
    except Exception as e:
        LOG.debug(f"Failed to fetch OpenID configuration: {e}")
    
    return client_session, openid_config
